crossRefs.note: For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves…
For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
“Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am…
Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to…
even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in…
to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord…
For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;
because it is written, “You shall be holy; for I am holy.”

translations.web: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.
translations.bsb: Then you will remember and obey all My commandments, and you will be holy to your God.
translations.kjv: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
translations.asv: that ye may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
